description: Operator-owned live acceptance. Replace all REPLACE_ fields; use an isolated storage directory. Existing task IDs are preserved on interruption.

cases.prompt: Prepare CC(=O)C as a project molecule with 3 conformers and seed 47. Preserve chemical state and use molecule_prepare.
Use the attached 3D ligand to search every stored conformer of our configured local library. Export the top 10 unique molecules as original and posed MOL2. Use ligand_library.

Run target_search for REPLACE_target using receptor REPLACE_absolute_receptor_path and the posed reference ligand REPLACE_absolute_reference_sdf_path. Use receptor chains REPLACE_explicit_author_chain_ids. Search the full configured library with the recorded default exploratory policy. Preserve the native binding reference and report coverage.

Run AF3 for one copy of this exact protein sequence with no ligand: REPLACE_exact_protein_sequence. Use exactly model seeds: [47,48]. Preserve the complete sequence. Report the saved CIF and recorded confidence.

Run an af3_batch named dimer_acceptance for exactly two copies of REPLACE_exact_protein_sequence, independently with these two ligands: CCO and CCN. Use shared MSA and exactly model seeds: [47,48]. These are separate complexes, not two co-ligands in one structure. Preserve literal chemistry. This is a runtime acceptance test, not a claim that these ligands bind.
